title: Construct a global integer bijection for the Hadamard/Gaussian pair with optimal bidirectional norm slack 1/2
body:
## Result
Construct a global error-one integer bijection for H4/2 and the Gaussian pair with bilateral radial supremum1/2. Every total error-one map has bilateral supremum at least1/2; a nonperiodic half-grid matching attains it. This improves the known global upper bound and separates finite-radius evidence from a global construction.

## Verification and limits
Universal proof, independent construction review, exact lattice checks and negative controls pass; the registered normal/optimized replay uses research/global-bilateral-half-gaussian-rounding. Exact sum, phase covariance and native order identities are not inherited. Forward-only optimality remains open. No tape/caller admission, assumption discharge or new kappa.

Reproduce: python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/global-bilateral-half-gaussian-rounding

Base e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance; credit #6509, #6619 and #2589. This is disclosed AI review, not human or formal-kernel verification.
